name: Apple
effect: Give one pet +1 Attack and +1 Health.
summary: The Apple is a Tier 1 Food, available in the Turtle Pack, the Puppy Pack and the Golden Pack. When a pet is fed an Apple, it receives +1 attack and +1 health. The Pear, Lasagna and Chicken Leg are generally considered to be direct upgrades to it. The Mouse and Worm will stock an Apple when sold/at the start of turn, at level 2 they will stock a Better Apple and at level 3 they will stock a Best Apple that give +2/+2 and +3/+3 respectively.

name: Honey
effect: Give one pet the Honey perk. Summon one 1/1 Bee after fainting.
summary: The Honey is a Tier 1 Food, available in theTurtle Pack. Feeding a pet Honey will give it the Honey perk. When a pet with Honey perk faints, it summons a level 1 Bee in its place.

name: Cupcake
effect: Give one pet +3 Attack and +3 Health until end of battle.
summary: The Cupcake is a Tier 2 Food. When a pet is fed a Cupcake, it gets +3/+3 until the end of battle.

name: Meat Bone
effect: Give one pet the Meat Bone perk. Attack with +3 damage.
summary: The Meat Bone is a Tier 2 Food, available in the Turtle Pack. Feeding a pet a Meat Bone will give them the Meat Bone perk. A pet with the Meat Bone perk attacks with +3 extra damage. This attack bonus does not affect abilities that are dependent on attack: Like Dodo or Leopard.

name: Sleeping Pill
gold_cost_note: overridden from default 3g (source text says costs 1 gold)
effect: Make one pet faint. Always on sale!
summary: The Sleeping Pill is a Tier 2 Food, available in the Turtle Pack and the Puppy Pack. When a pet is fed a Sleeping Pill, they're knocked out and are permanently removed from the team. However, this will also activate their Faint abilities. Sleeping Pill costs 1 gold, instead of the usual 3 for all other Foods. Sleeping Pill does not trigger Eats food abilities.

name: Garlic
effect: Give one pet the Garlic perk. Take 2 less damage. It can't be reduced to less than 2.
summary: The Garlic is a Tier 3 Food, available in the Turtle Pack. Feeding a pet Garlic will give it the Garlic perk. A pet with Garlic perk will take 2 less damage from all sources, although damage can't be reduced below 2.

name: Salad Bowl
effect: Give two random pets +1 Attack and +1 Health.
summary: The Salad Bowl is a Tier 3 Food, available in the Turtle Pack. Buying a Salad Bowl gives 2 random pets +1/+1. The Sushi or the Pizza could be considered direct upgrades to the Salad Bowl.

name: Bread
effect: Give one pet the Bread perk. End turn: Gain +7 Health until next turn
summary: Bread is a Tier 4 Food, available in the Turtle Pack. Feeding a pet Bread will give them the Bread perk. At the end of turn, a pet with the Bread perk will gain +7 Health until next turn.

name: Canned Food
effect: Give all current and future shop pets +1 Attack and +1 Health.
summary: Canned Food is a Tier 4 Food, available in the Turtle Pack and the Puppy Pack. When bought, instead of giving stats to pets currently on the team, it gives permanent +1 Attack and +1 Health to all current and future shop pets.

name: Pear
effect: Give one pet +2 Attack and +2 Health.
summary: The Pear is a Tier 4 Food, available in the Turtle Pack. Feeding a Pet a Pear increases its stats by +2 attack and +2 health permanently. Essentially, it's a better Apple but a worse Lasagna/Chicken Leg.

name: Chili
effect: Give one pet the Chili perk. Attack second enemy for 5 damage.
summary: Chili is a Tier 5 Food, available in the Turtle Pack. Feeding a pet a Chili will give that pet the Chili perk. Every time a pet with Chili perk attacks, it will deal an additional 5 damage to the pet in second space of the enemy's team. If there are no enemies in that space, Chili will not deal damage.

name: Chocolate
summary: The Chocolate is a Tier 5 Food that can be found in Any pack. When Chocolate is given to a pet, it will receive +1 Experience. Similar to when combining duplicate copies, each Chocolate/experience will also add +1 Attack and +1 Health. In Custom and Weekly pack, Crow can stock Chocolate upon being sold, and at higher levels will stock Better Chocolate and Best Chocolate that give +2 and +3 experiences respectively.

name: Sushi
effect: Give three random pets +1 Attack and +1 Health.
summary: The Sushi is a Tier 5 Food, available in the Turtle Pack. Buying a Sushi gives 3 random pets +1/+1. If there is only 1 or 2 pet(s) on the team then they gain with +1/+1 with the other 1 or 2 buff(s) being wasted.

name: Melon
effect: Give one pet the Melon perk. Take 20 less damage, once.
summary: The Melon is a Tier 6 Food, available in the Turtle Pack and the Puppy Pack. Feeding a Pet a Melon gives that pet the Melon perk. The first time a pet with Melon perk takes damage, the damage is reduced by 20, to a minimum of 0.

name: Mushroom
effect: Give one pet the Mushroom perk. Come back as a 1/1 after fainting.
summary: Mushroom is a Tier 6 Food, available in the Turtle Pack. Feeding a pet a Mushroom gives that pet the Mushroom perk. When a pet with the Mushroom perk faints, it summons a 1/1 copy of itself at the same level. Summoned copies are considered "new" pets, with almost no memory of their old selves before they faint. For example if a Parrot faints and comes back, it will not keep the copied abilities. However, Mushroom does remember the amount of ability triggers the pet has spent.

name: Pizza
effect: Give two random pets +2 Attack and +2 Health.
summary: The Pizza is a Tier 6 Food, available in the Turtle Pack. Buying a Pizza gives two random pets +2 attack and +2 health permanently. The Pizza can be considered as a direct upgrade to the Salad Bowl, as it gives twice the stats of it.

name: Steak
effect: Give one pet the Steak perk. Attack with +20 damage, once.
summary: The Steak is a Tier 6 Food, available in the Turtle Pack and the Puppy Pack. Feed a pet a Steak wil give that pet the Steak perk. The first time a pet with Steak perk attacks, it will deal an additional 20 damage.
